basics.name: Nevin Zheng
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer specializing in database and distributed data systems. ~5 years on Google BigQuery, then ~6 months at a seed-stage startup contributing to open-source Apache Iceberg and Gravitino. Looking to own hard problems end to end on a database or data infrastructure team that cares about doing things well, and to keep growing in technical leadership.

work.name: Datastrato
work.summary: Seed-stage startup building on Apache Gravitino (open-source data catalog) and an enterprise Iceberg REST Catalog.
highlights: Designed and implemented Apache Iceberg table encryption in the enterprise Iceberg REST Catalog, with keys referenced in an external KMS, key metadata served to query engines, and catalog-side metadata integrity checks.

Cut a Gravitino CI integration-test suite from ~1 hour to under 10 minutes (~10x) by profiling container lifecycles and moving to a shared Testcontainers instance per run; merged into Apache Gravitino.
Designed and prototyped tombstone-based soft delete and incremental / full-refresh materialized view maintenance against the draft Iceberg materialized view spec.
Contributed to Apache Iceberg spec discussions on REST catalog read restrictions, materialized views, and table encryption.
Self-initiated and prototyped Loom, a release-qualification CI/CD platform to catch regressions before release.
Led cloud security incident response and recommended review-gated infrastructure-as-code.

work.name: Google
highlights: Owned productionization of a novel streaming feature from local prototype to customer preview, driving the end-to-end testing strategy, release process, and SRE collaboration.
Drove design refinements and API negotiations across 3 core teams (BigQuery, WriteAPI, SRE) in a complex microservices architecture.
Implemented fixes during a critical production outage and contributed to the postmortem.
Owned end-to-end integration of row- and column-level security for a new table format, reaching feature parity for an enterprise product.
Designed a validation strategy across query surfaces (BigQuery API, Read API) that caught several critical bugs in dependent systems, preventing potential data leaks.
